addr: 56, Raj villa, 5th cross, 60 Feet Rd, 6th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: Beautiful ambience. Immaculate vibes. A bit overpriced, but not-too-bad an experience. It's warm and lively downstairs with the conversations over food and the live music that plays in the background while it's quiet and almost poetic upstairs, especially on a nice February evening.
This place always has the warmth ! I visited at afternoon when it wasn't crowded. Got a table. The drinks were nice. The food was delicious. Had the butter chicken tacos and they were really nice .
Service is very poor, messed up the order twice. Got raw chicken served and spiced up fries hiding as periperi fries. Very disappointing experience.
